name: agent-request
title: Agent Request
description: The agent asks the reader: to allow a tool call, or a question. A card for the composer's place (ComposerTakeover) in its frame, taking focus there, its icon beside its title and description (which name and describe it), what it is about under them (a command, a Questionnaire's choices, each led by its number, a checkbox after it where several may be chosen) and the reader's choices across its foot after a muted status ("Asked 4s ago"). Given its decision, it is one quiet row, as a step: the icon, what was asked and what came of it ("Allowed git push origin main", the question and its answer), its meta at the end ("Once · by you"); opened, the card as it was, to read, without its choices, a question's options listed with the chosen one marked. Given waiting, a still row for the conversation while the card is below ("Waiting for you below"). Several questions are one card, one at a time: a QuestionnaireProgress first in its footer and a QuestionnaireNavigation last, so there is always a way on; decided, each an AgentRequestQuestion over its options. While it asks, a chevron at its top end folds it to its title or header (collapsed, defaultCollapsed, onCollapsedChange; its words in labels), so the conversation over it can be read; its title opens it again, what was chosen in it kept. collapsible={false}: no chevron, a notice of one action in the composer's place (a sign-in, a limit reached). Of its title and a choice or two alone ("Working in another app", Take over), one row of 44px, the choices at its end on the card, no band under it and no chevron, at any width. AgentRequestError: why the reader's choice did not go through, over the footer, announced, in the destructive colour. Narrow, the AgentRequestStatus is a line of its own under the choices.
